verses.greek: Πέτρος ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκλεκτοῖς παρεπιδήμοις διασπορᾶς Πόντου, Γαλατίας, Καππαδοκίας, Ἀσίας, καὶ Βιθυνίας,
verses.literal: Peter an apostle of Jesus Christ To the elect sojourners of the Dispersion of Pontus Galatia Cappadocia Asia and Bithynia
verses.dgt: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen sojourners of the dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

verses.greek: κατὰ πρόγνωσιν θεοῦ πατρός, ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος, εἰς ὑπακοὴν καὶ ῥαντισμὸν αἵματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη.
verses.literal: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father by the sanctification of the Spirit unto the obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace would be multiplied.
verses.dgt: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, for obedience and sprinkling with the blood of Jesus Christ: may grace and peace be multiplied to you.

verses.greek: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ κατὰ τὸ πολὺ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἀναγεννήσας ἡμᾶς εἰς ἐλπίδα ζῶσαν διʼ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκ νεκρῶν,
verses.literal: Blessed be the God and Father of the Lord of us Jesus Christ the One according to the great of Him mercy having begotten again us to a hope living through the resurrection of Jesus Christ out from the dead
verses.dgt: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

verses.greek: εἰς κληρονομίαν ἄφθαρτον καὶ ἀμίαντον καὶ ἀμάραντον, τετηρημένην ἐν οὐρανοῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.literal: to an inheritance imperishable and undefiled and unfading reserved in the heavens for you
verses.dgt: into an inheritance imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, kept in heaven for you,

verses.greek: τοὺς ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ φρουρουμένους διὰ πίστεως εἰς σωτηρίαν ἑτοίμην ἀποκαλυφθῆναι ἐν καιρῷ ἐσχάτῳ.
verses.literal: who by the power of God are being guarded through faith for the salvation ready to be revealed in the time last
verses.dgt: who are being guarded by the power of God through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

verses.greek: ἐν ᾧ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε, ὀλίγον ἄρτι εἰ δέον λυπηθέντες ἐν ποικίλοις πειρασμοῖς,
verses.literal: in which you greatly rejoice for a little while at present if being necessary having been put to grief by various trials
verses.dgt: In this you rejoice greatly, though now for a little while, if necessary, you have been grieved by various trials,

verses.greek: ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου διὰ πυρὸς δὲ δοκιμαζομένου εὑρεθῇ εἰς ἔπαινον καὶ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: so that the proven genuineness of your the faith more precious than gold which is perishing through fire though being refined it may be discovered towards praise and glory and honor in the revelation of Jesus Christ
verses.dgt: so that the tested genuineness of your faith—more precious than gold that perishes though tested by fire—may be found to result in praise and glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: ὃν οὐκ ἰδόντες ἀγαπᾶτε, εἰς ὃν ἄρτι μὴ ὁρῶντες πιστεύοντες δὲ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε χαρᾷ ἀνεκλαλήτῳ καὶ δεδοξασμένῃ,
verses.literal: whom not having seen you love on whom now though not seeing believing now you yourself rejoice with joy inexpressible and glory-filled
verses.dgt: Though you have not seen him, you love him; though you do not see him now, yet believing in him you rejoice greatly with joy inexpressible and filled with glory,

verses.greek: κομιζόμενοι τὸ τέλος τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν ψυχῶν.
verses.literal: receiving the outcome of the faith of you the salvation of your souls
verses.dgt: receiving the outcome of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

verses.greek: Περὶ ἧς σωτηρίας ἐξεζήτησαν καὶ ἐξηραύνησαν προφῆται οἱ περὶ τῆς εἰς ὑμᾶς χάριτος προφητεύσαντες,
verses.literal: Concerning this salvation sought out and searched out diligently the prophets the of the toward you grace having prophesied
verses.dgt: Concerning this salvation, the prophets who prophesied about the grace that was to come to you searched and investigated carefully,

verses.greek: ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρὸν ἐδήλου τὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν παθήματα καὶ τὰς μετὰ ταῦτα δόξας·
verses.literal: inquiring into what or what manner of time was signifying the in them Spirit of Christ testifying beforehand the unto Christ's sufferings and the after these glories
verses.dgt: inquiring what person or what time the Spirit of Christ in them was indicating when testifying beforehand to the sufferings destined for Christ and the glories after these things.

verses.greek: οἷς ἀπεκαλύφθη ὅτι οὐχ ἑαυτοῖς ὑμῖν δὲ διηκόνουν αὐτά, ἃ νῦν ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν διὰ τῶν εὐαγγελισαμένων ὑμᾶς πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ἀποσταλέντι ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ, εἰς ἃ ἐπιθυμοῦσιν ἄγγελοι παρακύψαι.
verses.literal: to whom it was revealed that not themselves you however they were serving in those things which now have been proclaimed to you through those having evangelised you the Spirit Holy having been sent from heaven into which desire angels to look.
verses.dgt: It was revealed to them that they were serving not themselves but you in these things, which have now been announced to you through those who brought you the good news by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven—things into which angels long to look.

verses.greek: Διὸ ἀναζωσάμενοι τὰς ὀσφύας τῆς διανοίας ὑμῶν, νήφοντες τελείως, ἐλπίσατε ἐπὶ τὴν φερομένην ὑμῖν χάριν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: Therefore having girded up the loins of the mind of you being sober-minded fully do set your hope upon which is being brought to you grace in the revelation of Jesus Christ.
verses.dgt: Therefore, having girded up the loins of your mind, being sober-minded, set your hope fully on the grace being brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.

verses.greek: ὡς τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, μὴ συσχηματιζόμενοι ταῖς πρότερον ἐν τῇ ἀγνοίᾳ ὑμῶν ἐπιθυμίαις,
verses.literal: as children of obedience not fashioning yourselves to the former in the ignorance of you desires
verses.dgt: As children of obedience, do not be conformed to the former desires you had in your ignorance,

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸν καλέσαντα ὑμᾶς ἅγιον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἅγιοι ἐν πάσῃ ἀναστροφῇ γενήθητε,
verses.literal: But as the One having called you is holy also yourselves holy in all your conduct do be
verses.dgt: but as the one who called you is holy, you also become holy in all your conduct,

verses.greek: διότι γέγραπται ὅτι Ἅγιοι ἔσεσθε, ὅτι ἐγὼ ἅγιος.
verses.literal: because it has been written: that Holy you will be because I myself holy
verses.dgt: because it is written, “You shall be holy, because I am holy.”

verses.greek: Καὶ εἰ πατέρα ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸν ἀπροσωπολήμπτως κρίνοντα κατὰ τὸ ἑκάστου ἔργον, ἐν φόβῳ τὸν τῆς παροικίας ὑμῶν χρόνον ἀναστράφητε·
verses.literal: And if as Father you call on the One impartially judging according to the of each work in fear during the of the sojourn of you time do conduct yourselves
verses.dgt: And if you call on as Father the one who judges impartially according to each person’s work, conduct yourselves in fear during the time of your sojourn,

verses.greek: εἰδότες ὅτι οὐ φθαρτοῖς, ἀργυρίῳ ἢ χρυσίῳ, ἐλυτρώθητε ἐκ τῆς ματαίας ὑμῶν ἀναστροφῆς πατροπαραδότου,
verses.literal: knowing that not by perishable things — by silver or by gold — you were redeemed from the futile of you manner of life handed down from your fathers
verses.dgt: knowing that you were redeemed from your futile way of life handed down from your fathers, not with perishable things, silver or gold,

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ τιμίῳ αἵματι ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου καὶ ἀσπίλου Χριστοῦ,
verses.literal: but by the precious blood as of a lamb without blemish and without spot of Christ
verses.dgt: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot, the blood of Christ.

verses.greek: προεγνωσμένου μὲν πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, φανερωθέντος δὲ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτου τῶν χρόνων διʼ ὑμᾶς
verses.literal: foreknown indeed before the foundation the world having been revealed however in this last of the times for the sake of you
verses.dgt: He was foreknown before the foundation of the world but was revealed in the last times for your sake,

verses.greek: τοὺς διʼ αὐτοῦ πιστοὺς εἰς θεὸν τὸν ἐγείραντα αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ δόξαν αὐτῷ δόντα, ὥστε τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐλπίδα εἶναι εἰς θεόν.
verses.literal: who through Him believing in God the one having raised up Him out from the dead and glory Him having given so as for the faith of you and hope to be in God.
verses.dgt: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope are in God.

verses.greek: Τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἡγνικότες ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ἀληθείας εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον ἐκ καρδίας ἀλλήλους ἀγαπήσατε ἐκτενῶς,
verses.literal: The souls of you having purified by the obedience to the truth unto brotherly love sincere out of of heart one another do love fervently
verses.dgt: Having purified your souls by obedience to the truth for sincere brotherly love, love one another earnestly from the heart,

verses.greek: ἀναγεγεννημένοι οὐκ ἐκ σπορᾶς φθαρτῆς ἀλλὰ ἀφθάρτου, διὰ λόγου ζῶντος θεοῦ καὶ μένοντος·
verses.literal: born again not of seed perishable but of imperishable through the word living of God and abiding
verses.dgt: having been born again, not from perishable seed but imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

verses.greek: διότι πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς χόρτος, καὶ πᾶσα δόξα αὐτῆς ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου· ἐξηράνθη ὁ χόρτος, καὶ τὸ ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν·
verses.literal: because All flesh is like grass and all the glory of it like the flower of grass Withers the grass and the flower falls away
verses.dgt: For “all flesh is like grass, and all its glory like a flower of grass. The grass withers and the flower falls,

verses.greek: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα. τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν εἰς ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: the but the declaration of the Lord abides to the age. This now is the declaration which having been evangelised to you.
verses.dgt: but the word of the Lord remains forever.” And this is the word that was announced to you as good news.
